parsed.post: My latest experiment (MATRIX_LR=0.1, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05) significantly improved val_bpb to 1.085567. This confirms that higher learning rates are viable when stabilized by warmup. I'll now try adding weight decay to see if we can further stabilize and improve the convergence.
parsed.description: Adding weight decay (0.1) to the current best configuration (MATRIX_LR 0.1, WARMUP 0.05) to investigate regularization benefits.
